recursive_submodules: must match gitlinks in the pinned tree
ffmpeg: reuse Veyra's installed version; not needed by patch-01 core or Chiaki-native probe
reorder_queue_wrap_note: seq_num_16_add promoted to int and returned 65537 for 65535+2; a packet right after the 16 bit wrap was dropped while the queue held a gap. Not fixed upstream as of chiaki-ng 43728af (2026-11-03).
av_reorder_note: Video reorder wait policy: skip a missing packet at once when FEC can rebuild its frame, otherwise wait an adaptive 2..16 ms window; a reordered packet that arrives after a FEC skip within 16 ms is credited back as received in packet_stats so the loss report sent to the console matches the old policy; statistics published through chiaki_stream_connection_av_reorder_stats. CHIAKI_AV_REORDER_ADAPTIVE_DEFAULT=0 restores the old fixed 16 ms wait.
packet_stats_wrap_note: seq_max - seq_min of two 16 bit values promoted to int: the loss report covering the 16 bit wrap of the audio frame index (about every 11 minutes) claimed ~2^64 lost packets, and the console lowers its bitrate on reported loss (chiaki-ng #157, #871). Not fixed upstream as of chiaki-ng 43728af. The same patch stops a late or duplicate frame (more frames received than the range holds) from turning the whole range into reported loss.
udp_receive_buffer_note: SO_RCVBUF was the advertised data window (100 kB), smaller than one large video frame; the takion socket now asks for 4 MiB and halves while the system refuses (chiaki-ng #873, #817). The advertised a_rwnd is unchanged.
